title: Neural Modal Decomposition: Architectural Priors from Observables
abstract: arXiv:2609.14402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many engineering building blocks behave as multi-port linear time-invariant systems. RF cavities, photonic devices, and superconducting quantum chips, despite their different underlying physics, all share a common mathematical structure for their port-level response. Each entry of the response matrix is a sum of contributions from a small number of intrinsic resonant modes, the pole-residue form. A model capable of predicting such responses for arbitrary geometries and arbitrary port configurations, while simultaneously extracting the underlying eigenmode structure, would therefore establish a foundational design principle spanning all these domains. We propose a neural framework that learns this modal decomposition end-to-end, supervised only by system-level observables and without supervising the modal parameters themselves. The architecture decomposes into a port-independent pole predictor and two port-dependent coupling predictors

translated_title: 神经模态分解：源于可观测量的架构先验
translated_abstract: 许多工程构建模块表现为多端口线性时不变系统。射频腔、光子器件和超导量子芯片，尽管底层物理机制各不相同，其端口级响应却共享同一数学结构：响应矩阵的每个元素都是少量本征共振模态贡献之和，即极点-留数形式。一个能够预测任意几何形状和任意端口配置下此类响应、同时提取底层本征模态结构的模型，将因此建立一套跨越所有这些领域的基础设计原则。我们提出一个端到端学习这种模态分解的神经框架，其仅由系统级可观测量进行监督，而不对模态参数本身进行监督。该架构分解为一个与端口无关的极点预测器和两个与端口相关的耦合预测器。
tldr: 提出一种仅用系统级可观测量监督、无需直接监督模态参数的端到端神经框架，将多端口线性时不变系统的响应分解为极点-留数形式的本征模态，从而同时预测任意几何与端口配置的系统响应并提取底层本征模态结构。
en_tdlr: A neural framework that learns modal decomposition end-to-end supervised only by system-level observables, without directly supervising modal parameters, enabling prediction of responses for arbitrary geometries and port configurations while simultaneously extracting the underlying eigenmode structure.
